entities.name: RRC Connection Setup
entities.description: Procedure for establishing an RRC connection between UE and network.

entities.name: RRC Connection Reject
entities.description: Message sent by the network to reject an RRC connection request from the UE.

entities.name: Wait Time
entities.description: Indicates the time the UE should wait before attempting another RRC connection request.

entities.name: RRC Connection Reject Received
entities.description: Condition when UE receives an RRC Connection Reject message from the network.

entities.name: UE Waits for Wait Time
entities.description: UE behavior to wait for the specified duration before initiating another RRC connection request.

relations.description: RRC Connection Setup procedure includes sending RRC Connection Reject message.
RRC Connection Reject message contains Wait Time information element.
Receiving RRC Connection Reject establishes UE behavior to wait for Wait Time duration.
Wait Time IE guards the duration for which UE waits before next connection attempt.
